description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a worker thread pool system, including the IWorkerPool interface, the WorkerPool implementation, and nested classes for job scheduling, revocation, and monitoring within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread pool, providing methods for submitting, scheduling, rescheduling, revoking jobs, and obtaining snapshots and thread IDs.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of the IWorkerPool interface, managing a thread pool with scheduling, revocation, and monitoring capabilities, including nested Timer and Scheduler classes.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Timer
classes.description: Represents a scheduled timer associated with a job and the worker pool, used for timed job submission.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Scheduler
classes.description: Implements the scheduling interface for the thread pool, scheduling jobs via the timer.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Monitors dispatched jobs for analysis and reporting, including scheduling periodic checks.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor::MontiorJob
classes.description: A job class used internally by the monitor to perform analysis and reporting of dispatched jobs.

methods.name: JobType::Submit
methods.description: Submits the job to the worker pool for execution.

methods.name: JobType::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules the job to run at a specified time.

methods.name: JobType::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes the job, preventing it from executing if it hasn't already.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specific time.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job to a new time.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete and joins the worker threads.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for a given worker thread index.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current worker pool status and metadata.
